transcript:
[SFX: He gets there. We hear the creak of the door.]

DAVID (CONT’D): It’s a small cell. Empty except for a bookshelf. I'm going to check it out.

MARTIN: Hell no! What if you get locked in?

DAVID: Then send the police! Anyway, I'll prop it open with this brick.
[sfx: brick dragging on stone]

MARTIN: Okay, fine. Just as long as you're sure.

[PAUSE]

DAVID: Hmmm... There're a few mystery books... A bible... Oh... 

[SFX: We hear him pick up a book from the shelf.]

DAVID (CONT’D): This one says journal...

[SFX: We hear him pick up and leaf through a book]

DAVID (CONT’D): Inmate 3538, Joe Banks.

[SFX: He flicks through pages.]

DAVID (CONT’D, slow, labored reading): It looks like insane ramblings... “The demon lives here. I can hear its claws scraping to get into my mind. Please someone help me.”

DAVID (normal): Eesh.
